_comment: Home screen looks bundled into TV Setup. 'from' is a CleanYourTV theme folder; 'config' overrides it with a folder here; 'wallpapersFrom' borrows another theme's pictures. Order is the order on the phone.

looks.name: Nuvio Cinema
looks.desc: Made for OLED: true black, the focused app's artwork across the top, a glass dock and slow-rotating Earth-from-orbit photos.

looks.name: Aerial
looks.desc: Apple TV style: photos of Earth from the Space Station on pure black, shuffled every 15 minutes.

looks.name: Cinematic
looks.desc: OLED cinema look: one deep wallpaper in true colour, a six-app glass dock and the clock after two idle minutes.

looks.name: Midnight Glass
looks.desc: Dark backdrops (home cinema, Earth at night, a concert crowd) with the app's artwork on top and colour glow.

looks.name: Orba
looks.desc: Midnight blue with light waves along the bottom; tiles float with a soft halo in each app's colour.

looks.name: Ridgelines
looks.desc: Layered mountains that change with the time of day: misty mornings, golden hour, aurora at night.

looks.name: Christmas
looks.desc: Snowy nights, a fireplace and a Christmas market, a new picture every 20 minutes.

looks.name: Nature Calm
looks.desc: Twelve calm nature photos rotating every five minutes, with the place under the buttons.

looks.name: Glass
looks.desc: Navy with soft teal and violet light, the cinematic top shelf and a frosted dock.

looks.name: Red Rain
looks.desc: Crimson code rain on pure black.

looks.name: Onyx
looks.desc: No wallpaper: a deep charcoal canvas with a thin focus ring. The lightest look.

looks.name: Plain
looks.desc: The original CleanYourTV screen, no wallpaper.
